# Orchy AI

> Orchy AI is a hosted AI workspace for virtual assistants, freelancers and small agencies who work for several clients. Each client gets a separate workspace with its own apps, agents and files. You describe a task in plain words, the right agent does it in that client's apps, and Orchy asks for your approval before anything is sent, posted, paid, changed on a calendar, deleted or shared.

Key facts:
- Hosted only, at OVHcloud in Canada, with one isolated container per customer.
- Through One, Orchy can connect to 1,000+ apps (for example Gmail, Google Calendar and LinkedIn).
- AI runs on Orchy's own OpenRouter account, paid from the AI credit included in every plan. There is no bring-your-own AI key.
- Sign-up is open, with no waiting list. Plans are paid monthly and billed through Polar.
- Orchy is live. Plans are Solo $19, Team $59 and Agency $129 a month, each with AI credit included.
- Orchy holds no security certifications such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
- Orchy is a product of One Systems, Inc.

## Product
- [Client workspaces](https://imorchy.dev/client-workspaces): one workspace per client, with its own apps, agents and files
- [Approvals](https://imorchy.dev/approvals): what Orchy asks about before it acts, and how you approve or deny
- [Agents and the Agent Builder](https://imorchy.dev/agents): set up agents for a job in plain words
- [Apps through One](https://imorchy.dev/apps): connect each client's apps and choose what each agent may use
- [Pricing](https://imorchy.dev/pricing): paid monthly plans, AI credit and the 14-day refund rule
- [Security](https://imorchy.dev/security): hosting, isolation, included AI, deletion and sub-processors
